claim: The command rename did not break old clients. Every request recorded in captured.txt still gets a successful reply, an unknown command gets an error reply instead of an exception, and a request for a missing key gets an error reply too.
why: The Remove request in captured.txt fails with unknown command. canonical() lowercases the incoming name, but legacy.txt is loaded without lowercasing and holds the key Remove with a capital R, so the lowercased remove never matches it. The other captured requests, unknown commands and missing keys all behave as claimed, so a reader who skims the alias table and assumes names are matched alike on both sides confirms the claim wrongly.
